verdict.rationale: Tailscale has an official CLI documented at its reference page. Community users corroborate real CLI use (`tailscale cert`), and a first-party Aperture CLI exists specifically to configure and run coding agents. Missing for 10: detailed CLI documentation in the pack (command coverage, scripting/JSON output for agents), and hands-on evidence of agent-driven CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the Aperture CLI to discover, configure, and run coding agents that connect through your Aperture gateway.
